Which shortwave stations broadcast in Amoy?

In the A-26 schedule, 4 stations broadcast in Amoy. The most heavily scheduled include China Radio International, China National Radio 6, Radio Taiwan International, Adventist World Radio.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts in Amoy?

The most-used frequencies are 12010, 6165, 9420, 9610, 9730 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
